name: Scalable Distributed Volume Rendering (SDVR)
aliases: Distributed rendering system for unstructured data
definition: A distributed rendering system for unstructured data targeting large PC clusters, using OpenGL and MPI, designed for scalability where rendering time remains constant as data size and node count increase.
summary: Scalable Distributed Volume Rendering partitions massive unstructured datasets into load-balanced brick-shaped chunks for cluster rendering, maintaining constant rendering time as data and node counts increase.
